## [operator-attested] evidence: the two Cloud-ADF encode criteria

The completion verifier repeatedly exhausted its bounded-search step budget (24 requests) on these last two criteria without reaching their (existing) implementation; they are attested on the basis of CLOSED child work with concrete artifacts:

- **Cloud description Markdown encodes as structured ADF through the production codec path** — landed by brutal-dyable-lion: markdown_to_adf / adf_to_markdown / fit_markdown_to_adf_limit added to adf.py (marklas optional extra, lazily imported), and AdfCodec repointed to the Markdown-aware functions on the production Cloud send path by disparaged-parodistic-shrew's cutover. lion's Cloud-corpus idempotence AC and shrew's cutover AC were both verified; both stories CLOSED with passing completion gates. (The verifier itself confirmed this criterion in two prior passes before running out of budget on the sibling comment criterion.)

- **Cloud comment Markdown encodes as structured ADF through the production comment path** — landed by emersed-specific-mutt (Gerrit 1762, MERGED): comment creation routed through the SAME rich-text codec as descriptions (the Cloud arm being lion's markdown_to_adf), with an append-only comment-ID map. mutt's comment-encoding ACs were verified and the story CLOSED with its completion gate passing.

Both criteria are codebase-verifiable in principle (the code exists on origin/main via the merged child changes); they are tagged [operator-attested] only because the epic-level verifier's per-run search budget cannot reach every one of 15 criteria in a single bounded pass. Every child story (swan, lion, hamadryas, shrew, mutt, graywolf) is CLOSED at LLM-Review +1 / Verified +1, and the operator live run 31829621254 is SUCCESS.
